said.text: Nevin left me her small restaurant, its debts, and two cooks who still call it hers.
The bank wants the money we owe by closing time on Saturday.
The doors are open. Tap a cook, then tap a job. Hold a job button to insist.

sources.ref: Qur'an 2:43
Qur'an 4:103 (prayer at prescribed times)

A missed prayer is still owed (qada); sleep, forgetting and unconsciousness lift the blame, not the debt; the debt for a stretch of unconsciousness beyond five prayer times drops (Hanafi count, kept as the default): research/capacity-and-excuse-sources.md §0, §2, §4; research/decisions.md
Window boundaries (Fajr until sunrise, one-shadow Asr, red-twilight Maghrib) are the most common positions, chosen in research/decisions.md; agenda/prayer.ts
Qur'an 2:183
Qur'an 2:185 (the month of Ramadan)
Qur'an 2:187 (eat and drink until dawn, then complete the fast until nightfall)
Qur'an 2:184 (whoever is ill or on a journey: an equal number of days after)
Qur'an 2:185 (repeated; Allah intends ease, not hardship)
Which illness qualifies is the person’s judgment; the severity threshold is an engineering stand-in

Qur'an 2:184 continues: 'For those who can only fast with extreme difficulty, compensation can be made by feeding a needy person' (quran.com, checked 2026-10-03). Commonly read as covering chronic illness with no expected recovery (fidya instead of make-up); NOT modelled: every qualifying illness, chronic or acute, owes a make-up, because whether a condition is beyond recovery cannot be derived from body state
Qur'an 2:184 (whoever is ill or on a journey: an equal number of days after)
Qur'an 2:185
What counts as a journey is supplied by the host as a traveling flag
Qur'an 2:43
Qur'an 2:261
Qur'an 22:30 (shun words of falsehood; quran.com, checked 2026-10-03)
Qur'an 9:119 (be with the truthful)
Qur'an 5:38

Listed in CONSCIENCE_DEFAULTS.necessityEligible: taking food in extremity is a juristic extension of the 2:173 necessity exception by analogy (2:173 itself names forbidden food); not yet sourced in research/, recorded as an engineering assumption pending a Hanafi source
Qur'an 17:34
Qur'an 17:23
Qur'an 49:12

norms.label: Help and be good to neighbours

sources.ref: Qur'an 4:36 (be kind to neighbours; a command)
Standing recorded as recommended for everyday help beyond basic kindness is an engineering simplification; the verse itself is a command
Qur'an 2:152 (thank Me, and never be ungrateful)
Standing as recommended for expressed gratitude toward people is an engineering simplification
Qur'an 33:58 (abusing believers unjustifiably)
General prohibition of unjust harm to any person, extended from specific texts; scope of "without right" left to the host
Qur'an 5:90
Qur'an 2:173 ('if someone is compelled by necessity—neither driven by desire nor exceeding immediate need—they will not be sinful'; quran.com, checked 2026-10-03)
Qur'an 83:1-3 (woe to the defrauders)
Generalised to fair dealing for secular hosts

norms.label: Care for those who depend on you

sources.ref: Obligations toward family alongside those toward Allah and oneself (Bukhari 1968, as cited in research/islamic-foundations.md §2); extending it to every dependent’s urgent needs is the host’s reading
Standing obligatory for secular hosts as a shared caregiving norm; engineering default
Secular social norm; engineering default

norms.label: Pray the Eid prayer in congregation

sources.ref: Strongly emphasised in every school: wajib for Hanafis, sunnah mu'akkada (Maliki), sunnah (Shafi'i), fard kifaya (Hanbali), per TDV "Bayram" in research/eid-and-mourning-sources.md §1
Recorded as recommended (the most common standing overall, research/decisions.md), so missing it is no breach; congregational, with no individual make-up (eid-and-mourning-sources.md §1)
